text:
Aisha: FYI — after applying node taint change 'gpu-isolated=true:NoSchedule' to us-west1-gpu-pool, I'm seeing ~30 inference pods stuck Pending. Autoscaler didn't spin up nodes. Anyone else?
Ben: Yup, spotted it. ~20 Pending in us-west. CA logs show: 'NoNodeCandidates: no nodes match pod's nodeSelector/taint tolerations'
Carla: Which deployment? inference-worker or batch?
Aisha: mostly inference-worker and the canary. We rolled taint to isolate noisy encoders.
Aisha: kubectl describe node snippet:
```
$ kubectl describe node gpu-node-23
Name: gpu-node-23
Taints: gpu-isolated=true:NoSchedule
...
```
Ben: NoSchedule blocks scheduling unless pod has toleration. CA won't scale up a nodegroup unless there's a pod that can be scheduled on that node template. If podSpec lacks toleration and affinity for that pool CA thinks scale-up won't help.
Ben: Quick pod patch example:
```
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "gpu-isolated"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: "cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool"
            operator: In
            values:
            - us-west1-gpu-pool
```
Carla: We shouldn't blanket-tolerate all pods. Add toleration to inference-worker only. Also CA's nodeGroup config needs to be taint-aware (labels/expander) so it knows pods needing that taint can cause scale-up.
Aisha: Patched the canary deployment with toleration, restarted one pod — it scheduled ✅ but still 6 pending left.
Ben: I'll add a nodegroup override so CA recognizes GPU node templates for these tolerations. Opening PR to update cluster-autoscaler config and nodepool labels.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: patch applied to deployment/inference-worker-canary image:v1.2.3
Carla: Follow-up action items for runbook: (1) when adding NoSchedule taints to GPU pools, pre-update podtemplates for inference workloads with toleration; (2) ensure CA node group labels match nodeAffinity in pod specs; (3) pre-warm nodes using provisioner or keep minReplicas>0 for critical pools.
Aisha: Marking this resolved for now — will roll taint changes staged. :thumbsup:
Ben: PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 — adds nodegroup taint-aware config and docs.
Carla: Adding note to eng-infra runbook about 'taint-first vs template-first' ordering.
